game.q: a foreigner with nothing gathers grain in someone else’s field. why is that allowed?
opts: the law said leave some for the poor

wrong.finders: cute rule. not the real one.
wrong.sneak: they were looking. it was allowed on purpose.

game.right: YES. leave the edges and the dropped grain for the poor and the foreigner. a safety net, built into every harvest.

end.line: naomi came home empty and bitter. ruth wouldn’t leave her, and kindness kept showing up.

cliff.s2: grieving. and still, one line of hope.
